If <math><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2,3</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>, then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi></math> is equal to

solution.text:
